meta.name: stress_programmatic_pathfinding_dense_embed
meta.description: Stress test: Cylinder R=10mm H=30mm with ridge. 5 inlets (center + 4 @ r=6mm). Programmatic backend with A* pathfinding, spiral trunks, binary tree branching (depth 7), and voxel_merge_fallback collision strategy. WARNING: This spec is intentionally extreme and may exceed memory/time limits.
